title: Exams
note: A compact operational list replaces repeated large action rows. Counts here are illustrative.

title: Exam details
note: Keep full title and instructions; move utilities out of the opening action wall.

title: Timing & attempts
note: Explicit timezone display preserves current instant conversion; a selectable timezone is a separately scoped enhancement.

title: Answering rules
note: No restrictions are removed. High-impact restrictions get a consequence panel.

title: Identity & results
note: Keep identity requirements separate from scoring and decorative completion settings.

title: Questions & sections
note: A navigable outline replaces scrolling through every fully expanded question.

title: Sections & grading after attempts
note: Explain locked controls in place; preserve safe section deletion and grading power.

title: Appearance · Theme
note: Theme thumbnails improve discovery; explicit apply preserves independent saved snapshots.

title: Appearance · Opening
note: Copy and motion settings remain separate from exam timing.

title: Appearance · Instructions
note: All respondent instructions and fields remain visible; no new respondent disclosures are proposed.

title: Appearance · Brand & artwork
note: Keep visibility, asset selection, alternative text, badge, and caption controls.

title: Appearance · Style & audio
note: No color, renderer, decoration, footer, sound, or music control is removed.

title: Appearance · Completion
note: Retain confirmation, answer review, and conditional retry alongside configurable wording.

title: Preview studio
note: All nine current states, zoom, pan, pinch, keyboard controls, Fit one/all, and interaction mode remain.

title: Share & access
note: Keep respondent examiner codes and reviewer preview codes distinct in language, behavior, and placement.

title: JSON pro
note: Preserve upload/paste import and portable JSON with the existing lock. Richer validation is a proposed improvement.

title: Reports · Live attempts
note: Keep all filters, sorting, refresh, exports, classifications, and test-attempt separation.

title: Attempt review & recovery
note: Replace prompt-style recovery with explicit consequences and reason capture. Five minutes stays fixed.

title: Reports · Answer matrix
note: Keep full answer text, result filtering, autosaved answer previews, and presentation mode.

title: Reports · Question analytics
note: Retain counts, distributions, average timing, answer keys, and correct/incorrect respondent lists.

title: Organization templates
note: Preserve creation from four built-ins, default selection, revisions, update, duplication, archive, read-only archived access.

title: Files & image chooser
note: Keep search, grid/list, metadata, previews, download, visibility, usage references, upload retry/progress, removal and cleanup.

title: Workspace journey
note: Preserve exam-first / standard and top-level app selection. Global account and unrelated admin settings are outside this review.

title: Important admin states
note: Draft retention, errors, locks, role restrictions, empty results, and conflicts deserve designed states.
